name: genres
character: What each genre a piece can declare asks of its inferred chemistry. Every genre compose.py ships maps to a family, so a piece is never judged against an unstated default; a family holds only the constraints that genre is actually defined by, because a constraint the style does not care about would warn every good piece in it.
provenance: Starting values [start]: the family constraints are modelling choices read off each family's own definition (a dance genre is defined by a body-locking pulse, an ambient one by the absence of one), not fitted to annotated data. docs/NEUROCHEMICAL-AFFECT-PLAN.md section 4 says every chem.* row is WARN at most, so a family constraint can flag a piece but never fail it.

dance.why: a dance genre is defined by a pulse the body can lock to and by the drop or hook arriving.

song.why: a song carries a voice or a singable line, which is what the affiliative pool reads.

ambient.why: a bed is the subject: no pulse is wanted, and a sustained dissonance has to stay under the load a listener would call tense.

cinematic.why: a cue earns its hit and changes state with the picture; a flat cue that peaks once is not a score.

groove.why: a groove is a cell the body locks to; it is the whole subject, so it must carry the motor pool without a line.

texture.why: a texture piece is surface and grain; a drive would make it a groove instead.

jazz.why: a jazz performance changes state inside itself (solo, stop-time, a different feel); a single state is not the form.

short_form.why: a ringtone, alert or jingle has seconds to land its point, so the arrival carries the piece.

classical.why: a written form prepares its cadence and resolves it; both are measurable in the arc.

world.why: a traditional or regional genre is carried by a rhythm cycle; a piece with no body to it is a different form.

default.why: no family constraint: the row reports the measured signature and says the genre declared none.
